name: kibana-log-investigation
description: Install the local Kibana log investigation MCP from this repository.

interface.shortDescription: Local Kibana log investigation MCP for Codex
interface.longDescription: Use the repo-local read-only Kibana investigation MCP in Codex. Run connection-only bootstrap to create an empty managed catalog without importing examples, inspecting indexes, or editing client configuration.
defaultPrompt: Install the Kibana Log Investigation plugin from this repo, bootstrap Node.js if needed, and run connection-only bootstrap with --client none. Do not inspect indexes. After installation, ask me which exact index or pattern to configure before calling configure_index.
Use the Kibana Log Investigation plugin to inspect log sources and query a time window.
